artifacts.summary: Establishes that cols=files-lines (with a hand-rewritten 4-column header) covers Expressiveness/README.md and WeakCanonical/README.md, verified end-to-end on a scratch copy including an INV-FAIL corrupt/restore demonstration; and that it does NOT cover Kamp/README.md or NfMultiAnchorBridge/README.md's aggregated 'loose modules' row shape, which no existing generator option reproduces without silently dropping data or restructuring the table -- reported per NON-GOALS rather than worked around.

memory_candidates.content: scripts/check-module-invariants.sh's --emit-inventory generator never rewrites a BEGIN GENERATED block's header/separator itself -- render_block() carries the first row-shaped line found inside the block forward verbatim, with no validation against the cols=/desc=/rows= options or against the data rows' cell count. When changing a wrapped table's column set (e.g. cols=lines -> cols=files-lines), the header must be hand-rewritten to the new column count BEFORE the first --emit-inventory run; the generator will not detect or fix a mismatch.

scripts/check-module-invariants.sh's inventory generator has no option that reproduces an aggregated single-row summary of all loose files in a directory (e.g. a 'loose modules | 49 | 26,160' row). rows=subdirs silently DROPS such a row with no error or INV FAIL (the 'pinned row' mechanism only preserves rows whose key resolves to an actual file path); rows=both explodes it into one row per loose file instead. Any README using this aggregate-row shape cannot be wrapped without either data loss or a structural table rewrite, and is a genuine generator-coverage gap, not a header/option question.
